name: b2b-saas-starter
description: Cloudflare-first B2B SaaS starter monorepo with TanStack Start, Effect v4, Drizzle D1, Better Auth, and Alchemy.
author: Martin Brandhaug <martin@brandhaug.net>

scripts.dev: pnpm -C packages/i18n generate && vp run -r --parallel dev
scripts.build: pnpm -C packages/i18n generate && vp run -r build
scripts.validate: pnpm run check && pnpm run build && pnpm run infra:wrangler && git diff --exit-code -- apps/*/wrangler.jsonc && pnpm run db:migrate:local && pnpm run db:seed && CI=1 E2E_PORT=${E2E_PORT:-3097} pnpm run test:e2e
scripts.typecheck: pnpm -C packages/i18n generate && vp run -r typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm -C packages/i18n generate && vp run -r test
scripts.check: pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run lint && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run dead-code && pnpm run test && pnpm run test:scripts
scripts.check:fix: pnpm run lint:fix && pnpm run format
scripts.deploy: pnpm -C packages/i18n generate && alchemy deploy --stage prod --yes
scripts.deploy:stage: pnpm -C packages/i18n generate && alchemy deploy --yes --stage "${ALCHEMY_STAGE:?set ALCHEMY_STAGE, e.g. pr-42}"
scripts.infra:wrangler: node infra/write-wrangler.ts && vp fmt --write apps/api/wrangler.jsonc apps/background/wrangler.jsonc apps/web/wrangler.jsonc
